name: Polar Whaler
body:
Polar Whaler
CR 7

XP 3,200
Male human barbarian (polar whaler) 8
CN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +4; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 armor, +1 deflection, +4 Dex, –2 rage)
hp 97 (8d12+40)
Fort +12; Ref +7; Will +3
Resist cold 4
Speed 40 ft., swim 20 ft.

OFFENSE

Melee +1 harpoon +14/+9 (1d8+8/x3)
Ranged +1 harpoon +13/+8 (1d8+8/x3)
Special Attacks I stab at thee, rage (27 rounds/day), rage powers (energy resistance [cold], guarded life, low-light vision, scent)

STATISTICS

Str 21, Dex 19, Con 20, Int 6, Wis 6, Cha 14
Base Atk +8; CMB +13 (+14 grapple with harpoon); CMD 26
Feats Blind-Fight, Charging Hurler, Extra Rage, Point-Blank Shot, Two-Handed Thrower
Skills Acrobatics +11 (+15 when jumping), Climb +12, Handle Animal +7, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +5, Survival +5, Swim +20; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping
Languages Common
SQ fast movement, man o’erboard, reel her in
Gear belt of foraging, +1 leather armor, +1 harpoon, ring of protection +1, cloak of resistance +1

Base Statistics When not raging, the whaler’s statistics are: AC 18, touch 15, flat-footed 14; hp 81; Fort +10, Will +1; Melee +1 harpoon +12/+7 (1d8+5/x3); Ranged +1 harpoon +13/+8 (1d8+5/x3); Str 17, Con 16; CMB +11, CMD 26; Skills Climb +10, Swim +18.
